controls.name: unset-stamp-reads-zero
controls.why: built_from reads a never-stamped store as stamp 0 (the 'not known is zero' mistake): an unstamped store looks current at token 0

controls.name: unset-token-not-zero
controls.why: token() reads an unset token as -1 instead of 0: a store stamped at zero looks stale on a fresh namespace

controls.name: os-fresh-without-data-check
controls.why: Fresh without its $Data(...) # 2 guard: an unset stamp is read as "" and compared with the token
controls.find:
Val::Unset => false,
        Val::Empty => false,
        Val::Int(i) => i == token(t),
controls.replace:
Val::Unset => token(t) == 0,
        Val::Empty => false,
        Val::Int(i) => i == token(t),

controls.name: stale-list-drops-unstamped
controls.why: stale_stores skips stores that were never stamped
controls.find: if built_from(stamps.last()) != Some(token(t)) { rest.push(stamps.last()) } else { rest }
controls.replace: if built_from(stamps.last()) is Some && built_from(stamps.last()) != Some(token(t)) { rest.push(stamps.last()) } else { rest }
